page.layout: One page of verse, set in italic, one block of text; a catchword "Nec" at the lower right, below the last line.

p.i: Signum immane crucis laetae longo ordine gentes Poplite procumbunt flexo, precibusque salutant. Nec procul impositam sublimi vertice montis Obsedere arcem praeruptis aspera saxis Stant loca, difficilesque aditus moesta agmina circum. Longo fessa labore sedent, cum protinus inter Sublimes nebulas dextra Deus ipse migrantem Flammam intorquet agens, ruit illa micantibus astris Turbinis in morem, totumque illapsa repente Moclinium involuit, missi simul aethere venti Spirantes aderant, infusaque flumina pesti Dant animos, volitant obscura in nube fauillae Ardentes, nimbusque ad sydera fumidus vndat.

Hinc superum auxilio freti, & felicibus armis Moenia Granatae veniunt, denseque coronant Milite, non aditus clausae, non exitus vrbi Amplius, hic flauis vndantia messibus arua, Oppidaque, ac pagos disperfis ignibus vri Fecerat, & magnis quassatam molibus vrbem Ex angui trepidare metu. Mox ecce reclusa Improuisus adest porta, mediosque per hostes Barbarus it, ramum dextra praetendit oliuae, Tela sub ingenti letalia veste latebant Illum composito vultu premere ore videres Velle dolos iam ferrum aperit, iam percutit, & iam Poenituisse putes, meritaque ibi morte peremptus Concidit, obruiturque ingestis insuper armis.

page.notes: Catchword "Nec" printed at lower right. The line "Sublimes nebulas" and the other lines are transcribed as printed; the s long s is rendered as s, and the final line of text is followed by the catchword. Some letters in the italic are uncertain, notably "Moclinium" and "Spirantes", and should be checked against the scan.
